summary: Iteration 8 (backend + frontend): Premium (Stripe) & Filters. Backend: 16/16 pytest passed against /app/backend/tests/test_premium_filters_iter8.py — covers Stripe checkout for lifetime & monthly (both return url+session_id, payment_transactions record inserted with payment_status='pending'), invalid plan → 400, status/{session_id} for own session → 200, unauthorized session → 403 (via seeded txn for another user), /premium/me shape (free: premium=false, daily_swipes_limit=10, remaining_swipes>=0), swipe decrements remaining_swipes, forcing daily_swipes_used=10 → next swipe 402 with 'daily swipe limit', flipping premium=true → /premium/me returns premium:true & remaining_swipes:null AND swipe bypasses 402, discovery sorting (premium first then compatibility desc), discovery profession & availability filters return only matching cards, projects filter (looking_for=designer & min_hours=10 & max_hours=30 & min_equity=5 & max_equity=20) excludes non-matching, my_city_only returns only same-city projects. Frontend (mobile 390x844 viewport, test@cofound.com): 1) /premium loads (data-testid='premium-screen'), both plan cards render (lifetime default selected, monthly clickable), CTA button (data-testid='premium-checkout-btn') fires POST /api/premium/checkout returning 200. 2) Projects: filter icon opens modal (data-testid='projects-filter-btn'), designer chip + min_hours=10 apply → active filter chips ('Role: Designer', '10-∞H/Wk') + 'Clear all' render at top, filtered list shows only designer projects. 3) Discover: filter icon opens modal (data-testid='discover-filter-btn'), profession/availability/city inputs work, apply reloads cards. Deprecation warnings still present ('shadow*' and 'props.pointerEvents') — carried over from iter 4-7, non-blocking.

minor.issue: When session_id is truly unknown (never created), returns 404 'Session not found' rather than 403 for other-user's session; behavior is correct — 403 is only reached when a txn exists but belongs to another user (verified via seeded txn). Test-plan step #3 wording ambiguous.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated in RN 0.75+/react-native-web. Migrate to boxShadow. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme/index.ts (theme.shadow.*), used across premium/index.tsx, projects.tsx, discover.tsx.
props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents. Reference: any Touchable/Pressable in the tree emitting this warning.

action_items: MEDIUM (code review): /app/backend/database.py:15 hardcodes `db = client.cofound_db` — this ignores DB_NAME env var and violates the environment-variable-only contract. Change to `db = client[os.getenv('DB_NAME','cofound_db')]` so DB_NAME in backend/.env is respected. (Tests had to hardcode 'cofound_db' to compensate.)
LOW (carried): Migrate theme.shadow.* helpers to boxShadow-compatible form (RN 0.75+/react-native-web deprecation).
LOW (carried): Replace deprecated props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents.

LOW: Consider adding STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET support & signature verification path — current polling via /premium/status handles activation reliably in dev, but production webhook path won't verify signatures without the secret (backend code correctly falls back).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/database.py:15 hardcodes cofound_db → ignore DB_NAME env var. Break of contract.
premium.py `_apply_premium` correctly sets premium flag; both /status polling path (line 170) and webhook (line 254) are idempotent by checking existing payment_status != 'paid'.
server.py /api/swipe correctly enforces daily_swipes limit BEFORE recording the swipe (line 441), so limited swipes are not persisted.
server.py /api/discovery/cards sort is deterministic — premium boost + compat score desc (line 410-414).
server.py /api/projects filters compose correctly, including my_city_only via same-city user_id set (line 845-854).
premium.py PLAN_PRICES enforces server-side price registry — client cannot inject amount. Good.
